provenance.label_policy: MACHINE-ONLY reading hypotheses; no human, calligrapher, paleographer, or expert verified these labels. Confidence values are subjective and uncalibrated, not probabilities of historical truth. Labels are lowercase normalized word readings, not glyph-exact diplomatic transcriptions: long-s is normalized to logical s, case and graphic allographs are not distinguished, and uncertain historical spelling/abbreviation may remain. Original pixels preserve allograph forms, joins, and abbreviations. A one-shape-per-character renderer cannot model that distinction. Whole-word boxes are machine-selected from projection proposals, not letter cutouts or manual tracing; neighboring-line ink and pale-stroke boundary uncertainty remain. Below-threshold hypotheses remain recorded rather than relabeled or silently treated as verified. Generated texts are synthetic combinations of the admitted training alphabet, not claims about manuscript wording.

config.renderer: evo polygon nib sweep; 32 intervals; 3x supersampling; constant ink; no RNG

objective.normalization: Independent per-crop Otsu; tight foreground; uniform scale to 48px height; centered alignment
objective.selection: Mean training-image loss only; all heldout metrics computed after fitting

limitations: Fixed catalog topology and stroke count; bounded coordinates cannot discover missing strokes or new allographs.
One geometry per exact Unicode character; no contextual allographs or learned joins.
Machine transcription hypotheses and unverified hand identity are not historical ground truth.
Image similarity is not OCR accuracy, legibility, or evidence of recovered historical ductus.
Per-crop thresholding may retain bleed-through or marginal noise; no letter segmentation or manual tracing.
Geometry-only rendering excludes stochastic ink, paper, weathering, and scribal motion dynamics.
Single-page heldout crops measure local transfer only, not independent-manuscript generalization.
